fields.description: The calendar day the figures describe (YYYY-MM-DD), shown as "As of <date>".

The range a viewer starts from, counted back from asOf (or today): one of last-7-days, last-30-days, last-90-days, month-to-date, quarter-to-date, year-to-date, last-12-months, or a custom {from, to} of YYYY-MM-DD days. A shared link is fenced to it.
One line naming the question the dashboard answers, shown under its title.

The figures are synthetic, shown to illustrate the view — viewers see an Illustrative data chip.
